expected.rules: Recompute counts from table; compare to literals. Candidate delta +3 is distinct from 28 existing bridge instances in four historical rows. Expected counts never synthesize missing rows. 5508 single /4 multi count reconstructed distinct raw provider tuples, not non-null field count. Reconstruct all relevant sources, then verify these expected counts. Unknown source joins fail closed.
expected.preregistration_note: Method outcome is conditional on all content rows resolving; any content contradiction takes global INCONCLUSIVE_SAVED_CONTENT_IDENTITY priority, worst method still UNVERIFIED.

b2a.reason: Final code pin matches adjudication but models.json is unchanged across correction; no run-specific pre-correction loaded-code binding among these inputs. Reading final hash routine is not proof of historical production.

road_catalog.reason: Sealed code pin in approval; no run receipt binds loaded code to observed pid. Algorithm RAW_ENTRY_BYTES is source-declared, not independently runtime-bound.

b4a3.reason: Inherited road catalog pins; no third independent payload calculation.

method_binding.rule: Require per-source state without default. Worst value of sources actually compared is global. INDEPENDENT_PIN_MATCH is forbidden for these inputs. Cross-source pin equality is DECLARED_PIN_MATCH; B4A3-only inheritance is INHERITED_PIN_MATCH.

comparison: package_sha256 + normalized_prefix + normalized_entry + model_sha256; package_locator preserved but excluded from content equality
excluded_inputs: all WRP/PBO/P3D/RVMAT/PAA/material paths mentioned in the JSON inputs
all files not explicitly listed in files or methods or the oracle pin

source_binding.b4b0_report_contract_sha: report.contract_sha256 and consumer.contract_sha256 must equal pinned b4b0_contract.sha256
source_binding.consumer_nature: consumer.json is an independently generated JSON result report, NOT executable code; recovery receipt source_report_sha256/consumer_sha256 must match both files. No independently recorded child executable identity.
source_binding.groups: B4B0 table defines complete reference names/counts and immutable historical fields, NOT a complete provider list: four rows are null. Reconstruct candidate provider records from all pinned B2A models/package joins and READ_STRICT road models/entry/package joins, then group by content key. For non-null historical provider require an exact raw record in reconstruction; for null preserve null and require historical PROVIDER_CONFLICT issue plus at least two raw records. Never fill history from saved-provider-comparison or from new groups.
source_binding.b2a_package_join: Exact locator lookup in b2a_report.packages for prefix and sha. b2a_config.package_pins confirms SHA only: value either a hex string or dict with sha256. Require equal SHA. No prefix from config, no path normalization/open. Missing or conflicting lookup is unresolved or malformed.
source_binding.normalization: ASCII slash replacement, lowercase and strip exterior slash independently on prefix and entry; reject empty, interior empty components, dot/dotdot, colon, control, non-ASCII; preserve spaces. Join with one slash and require equality to normalized reference.
source_binding.sha: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal ASCII characters; reject bool/null/default.
source_binding.conflict: Same package SHA and normalized virtual entry with different model SHA => BLOCKED_SHA_CONFLICT. Record observed_keys, zero accepted groups; no identity-count credit.
source_binding.provenance_rule: One provenance per candidate model source row: b2a_models pointer /index, prefix from its exact package lookup in report; config confirms only SHA; road_models JSONL parsed as ordered array pointer /lineindex, entry raw/sha/mime from road_entries and prefix/package from b4a3_summary.pbo. source_file_sha binds candidate model source, auxiliary joins are mandatory from other listed pinned inputs. Consumer independently validates those joins and pointer resolution. Full source records are compared raw before content normalization; do not deduplicate away provenance. Each raw provider tuple is sorted/deduplicated only for single/multi denominator; group retains source-row provenances.
source_binding.new_references: The three rows with source_instances==0 require NEW_REFERENCE_WITH_B4A3_PIN historical state and matching previous:assets/ pin from b4a3_contract. Not all 265 road entries become scene references: visit B4B0 table universe only.
source_binding.road_gates: Road prefix must match; exactly one distinct entry tuple(name,sha256,mime,size) and one model tuple(sha256,status) for normalized relative name; exact integer mime==0; status READ_STRICT; model_sha==entry_sha; previous:assets/ SHA equal when that pin exists. If a relevant candidate is excluded, record a rejected_provenance and reason; never use it as group member. Missing catalog candidate for unrelated name is not a rejected provider.
source_binding.jsonl: road_models pointer /N means physical zero-based line N split by LF, decode UTF8 and parse each nonempty line as one JSON object. A single trailing empty split segment after final LF is ignored; interior empty/whitespace-only lines rejected; no index shifting. CR preceding LF accepted as JSON whitespace. Pointers for other files follow JSON Pointer with ~0/~1 decoding.
source_binding.history: For non-null history exactly one distinct reconstructed RAW provider tuple must exist and equal history; otherwise row MALFORMED with HISTORY_PROVIDER_MISMATCH. For null history retain null, require at least two distinct canonical RAW provider tuples (not source-row duplicates), and exact issue code PROVIDER_CONFLICT and detail multiple distinct providers for <name>; row historical_issue_pointer points to /issues/N. Otherwise MALFORMED. Method uncertainty never upgrades status.

report_schema.strict: All keys listed here required; no unknown keys, bool/int coercions, NaN or defaults; pointers resolve in pinned exact source bytes.
report_schema.types: names/aliases strings; counts nonnegative exact integers; groups/provenances/inputs/table arrays; historical_provider preserved JSON. physical_precedence_unknown literal true. Claims exactly contract claims. by_state/by_method maps contain every enum with integer count. observed_keys counts distinct observed complete keys; absent/invalid keys not invented. historical_issue_pointer is explicit null for historical non-null provider or a string pointer for conflict; issues and rejected_provenances lists, all fields present.
report_schema.states: History contradiction overrides row state to MALFORMED. Otherwise Malformed key/name => MALFORMED. Missing provenance/pin join => UNRESOLVED. Same-PBO contradictory SHA => BLOCKED_SHA_CONFLICT. Otherwise one primary provider => SINGLE_PINNED_CONTENT; multiple and one group => SAME_PINNED_CONTENT; multiple groups => DISTINCT_CONTENT. Incomplete keys contribute no group. Method uncertainty is orthogonal, always retained.
report_schema.global: Any malformed/unresolved/distinct/blocked row => INCONCLUSIVE_SAVED_CONTENT_IDENTITY; otherwise any compared METHOD_UNVERIFIED => INCONCLUSIVE_METHOD_BINDING; otherwise SAVED_CONTENT_IDENTITY_VERIFIED_ONLY. Always include worst method_binding_global. No current physical/native/build acceptance.
report_schema.coverage: Sorted unique names, all original rows/counts/aliases/providers unchanged; provenance indices within same row unique and complete; each pinned source used is listed; indices and JSON pointers cannot refer outside allowlist. Groups sorted by four-part key. Consumer reconstructs membership independently.
